'''Dustin Starbucks''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Michigan State Championship]] on 28 April 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|TIE retrieval Hunt Down]], according to Jason Aubry's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2200">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-trench-runners-mi-state-champs-tr-4-28d2200/ trench-runners-mi-state-champs-tr-4-28], DeckTech (Jason "TrenchRunner" Aubry, 30 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-trench-runners-mi-state-champs-tr-4-28d2200/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
